title_voiceover: Let's continue with our outline. We're focusing on disorders of hemoglobin structure and synthesis, as well as disorders of iron metabolism and heme synthesis. Within hemolytic anemia, we'll examine autoimmune hemolytic anemia, abnormalities of RBC membranes, enzyme disorders, paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria, and acquired hemolysis. Under other categories, we'll cover megaloblastic anemias, aplastic anemia, red cell aplasia, and RBC morphology patterns you need to recognize clinically.
